text:
Eli Navarro: hey all, super excited to join Redwood Inference! :wave: I’m Eli — joining infra eng from Toronto (EST). I like board games, sourdough baking, and terrible puns. first day remote today, will be online most of the day. quick Q: where do new hires put their mailing address for swag/stickers?
Maya Chen: welcome Eli!! :tada: we put that in the #new-hires channel thread or DM people-ops. also curious about the sourdough — recipe or trade? :bread:
Eli Navarro: thanks Maya! I’ll DM people-ops. and yes, sourdough recipe incoming if anyone wants it. i bake on weekends.
Sam: hi Eli — welcome to the team. huge board game nerd here too. what’s your go-to? :game_die:
Eli Navarro: hey Sam — long answer but TTRPG-adjacent: I love root, but I’ll play anything from catan to spirit island.
People Ops Bot: @Eli Navarro — welcome! Please fill out the "New Hire Shipping" form: https://redwood.example.com/ship-form so we can send swag. If you prefer not to receive anything, reply here. :package:
Juno: yo welcome! also FYI we do a monthly "lunch & learn" where people demo hobbies. if you wanna show off your baking we can schedule you in. :popcorn:
Eli Navarro: that sounds awesome, I’d love to do a mini bake demo (virtually) — can sign up.
Avery: welcome Eli! if you want sticker recs LMK — we did a community sticker swap last month that was chaos in the best way. :stickers:
DevEx: If you see any onboarding docs missing or confusing, ping me. also, our remote-first onboarding slack checklist is pinned in #new-hires.
Rafael: welcome Eli. also — fun fact: our office in SF has a snack drawer that judges sourdough strictly. :judge:
Sam: recipe trade!!! I’ll trade you a perfect 20-minute focaccia for a starter.
Eli Navarro: deal. I’ll bring starter to the (eventual) office bake day? I’m in EST but travel to SF occasionally.
Maya Chen: omg yes please. also, we have a tiny Bake-Off channel that sparks joy. 
People Ops Bot: Shipping form received from @Eli Navarro. ETA for swag pack: 7–10 business days after form submission.
Juno: also if anyone wants to coordinate timezone-friendly coffee chats, drop your availability. Eli, looks like EST afternoons work for a lot of people.
Eli Navarro: afternoons are perfect for me (2–6pm EST). happy to do coffee chats.
Avery: welcome again!! ps — any dogs? cat people or both? :dog: :cat:
Eli Navarro: dog person! have a corgi named Mochi — will spam photos at low frequency. :dog2: :brown_heart:
Sam: must see corgi pics. mandatory onboarding ritual. :joy:
DevEx: tagging onboarding checklist: please confirm you’ve joined core channels, completed identity verification, and set up 2FA. quick link: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/checklist
Eli Navarro: confirmed joined channels, identity verification queued, will finish 2FA before end of day. thanks everyone for the warm welcome! :smile:
Rafael: welcome aboard Eli. if you ever want to pair on infra stuff or kernel-level roast debates, ping me.
People Ops Bot: Note: new-hire welcome lunch scheduling will be sent by People Ops next week.
Maya Chen: adding Eli to the Bake-Off sign-up sheet now. :sparkles:
Eli Navarro: thanks again all — excited to get stuck in. Mochi may audition as team mascot. :dog2:
